name: Jellyfin YouTube Plugin
description: Stream YouTube videos as Jellyfin Series without downloading them. Uses .strm files + local stream proxy + YoutubeExplode + yt-dlp fallback.
overview: Add YouTube channels and stream their videos directly as Series in Jellyfin. No download to disk. SQLite database isolated from Jellyfin's main DB. Configurable polling per channel and retention policies. YoutubeExplode works out-of-the-box without external binaries; falls back to yt-dlp if installed.
changelog: - v0.0.0.2: Configuration page functional via Jellyfin built-in endpoints, YoutubeExplode primary resolver + yt-dlp fallback, WatchedTracker subscribed to PlaybackStopped events
